messages:
anna-cs: Quick update: Coastline's private deploy cutover hit intermittent failures last night. Their analytics -> inference requests sometimes time out. Marking renewal watch until we confirm stability. :triangular_flag_on_post:
jules-net: I pulled VPC flow logs and saw SYNs from 10.50.8.0/24 dropped en route. No SG denies; routing looked ok but next-hop showed micro-flaps. Scheduling MTU probe + traceroute on their path now.
hira-sec: IAM/KMS check: their cross-account role coastline-log-writer exists, but KMS alias/redwood/coastline-logs has no explicit grant for external principal. Their key policy prevents external principal usage so we must create a grant. I'll prepare the grant request and a customer consent template for legal.
mike-sre: repro snippet from their bastion at 03:18 UTC:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://inference.private/health || echo FAIL
# Sometimes returns 000 after long connect time
```
I captured a 60s pcap and uploaded to the runbook ticket. Seeing retransmits and occasional RTOs. Might be MTU or a transit GW hiccup.
anna-cs: important: renewal check-in in 6 days. Need artifacts to show remediation progress. Please share one-line confirmations as tasks complete.
jules-net: temporary mitigation: adding a test route for 10.50.8.0/24 via our transit gw at 09:15 PT, TTL 90m. Will monitor.
hira-sec: created INFRA-9188 for cross-account KMS grant (owner=hira-sec). Also proposing interim flow: customer writes logs to an S3 bucket in their account and provides presigned POSTs for our ingestion. Drafting consent language.
ops-bot: [ticket-created] INFRA-9188: cross-account KMS grant for coastline (owner=hira-sec, due=1788885200).
mike-sre: ran test at 09:22 PT after route. Retransmits dropped from ~18% -> ~2% during 20m window. Uploaded grafana snapshot and pcap to INFRA-9188. Found one ENI with MTU 9001; asked customer to set to 1500.
rachel-pm: I'll update renewal tracker: moving status from "at-risk" -> "watch" if final smoke passes and KMS grant proceeds. Anna, can you draft a 1-slide summary for the renewal panel showing timeline and mitigations?
anna-cs: yes. Owners: jules -> revert temp route after 90m if stable; hira -> complete grant or S3 interim; mike -> final smoke + graphs. Drop one-line when done.
jules-net: temp route removed at 10:50 PT; metrics stayed stable.
hira-sec: compliance approved presigned S3 interim. Sent customer consent template; awaiting signed email. Grant ticket still open for long-term solution.
mike-sre: final smoke at 11:15 PT: 15m window clear, p99 latency within SLA. Uploaded final artifacts to INFRA-9188.
anna-cs: thanks team. Preparing renewal update email now with attachments. Action item: hira to prepare a 1-pager on KMS grant vs key policy for the runbook (to help future onboardings). Target EOD tomorrow.
hira-sec: ack. Will draft 1-pager and post here when ready.
Note: thread contains the chronological channel conversation for Coastline private VPC cutover and onboarding actions.
